verdicts.reason: A breaks the main message. The SALE letters are tiny and sit at the bottom edges of oversized, mostly empty circles that are jammed against the right edge of the canvas. 'NEW YEAR SPECIAL' has shrunk to a small, off-centre label at the top-left. The lanterns, clouds and ingots are duplicated and scattered, so there is no clear focal point. B is the original shrunk into a band across the middle, with about 35% of the canvas left as empty yellow above and below. That is a letterbox, not a rearrangement for the story format, and the headline and SALE are small for the format. Still, B keeps the hierarchy, symmetry and legible lettering intact, so it is the less bad of the two.
